spec.title: Model serving
spec.description: State the operator reports for the modelServing capability

spec.expr: max by (component) ((kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~"modelServing", state="DisabledByPlan"} == 1) * 0 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~"modelServing", state=~"Ready|ExternalReady"} == 1) * 1 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~"modelServing", state="Progressing"} == 1) * 2 or (kamiwaza_platform_component_state{namespace="$namespace", component=~"modelServing", state="Blocked"} == 1) * 3)

spec.title: Model deployments
spec.description: Ready condition, reason, and replicas per ModelDeployment

spec.title: Serving CPU by model
spec.description: CPU cores used by each ModelDeployment's pods

spec.expr: sum by (label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace", container!=""}[$__rate_interval]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name!=""}))

spec.title: Serving memory by model
spec.description: Working-set memory of each ModelDeployment's pods

spec.expr: sum by (label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$namespace", container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) max by (namespace, pod, label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name) (kube_pod_labels{namespace="$namespace", label_serving_kamiwaza_ai_deployment_name!=""}))
